integrated_interpretation: The first-seed300point fills the gap between200and400: average depth error trends down, but local gains are nonmonotonic and boundaryF1 declines with more data in these paired best models. Qualitative panels support mostly surface-value correction with inherited structural limitations; do not generalize the one-seed curve to an established sample-size law.
